title: Record the first component of native frame 1
body:
## Summary
- Stored frame 1 is the nine axes `[256, 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1]`.
- The published formula returns the unnormalized constant vector for rank 9, so the first component is real `1`, imaginary `0`, at exponent `0`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The other 1,003 frames are not evaluated.
